name: architecture-postgresql-internals
description: Use when the user asks about Postgres MVCC, the write-ahead log (WAL), table bloat, autovacuum, dead tuples, transaction ID wraparound, checkpoints, HOT updates, EXPLAIN ANALYZE or why Postgres is slow. Produces diagnosis queries and tuning settings. Not for schema design (use data-relational-database) or sharding (use architecture-database-scaling).
